bibl.title: Saubhāgyacandrātapa
bibl.note: Unni, N. Parameswaran (1995). Nilakantha Diksita. Delhi: Sahitya Akademi.

Only two chapters of the Saubhāgyacandratapa survive, preserved in a single manuscript at the Kerala University Manuscripts Library, Trivandrum (No. 2941). Nīlakaṇṭha argues that worship of Parāśakti—the Goddess as Supreme Being—alone leads to liberation, expounding the discipline of the sādhaka with reference to numerous Tāntric and Āgamic texts.
